import pandas as pd
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Config
MODEL_NAME = "bert-base-uncased"
MAX_LENGTH = 128
BATCH_SIZE = 32
EPOCHS = 2
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

# Prepare identity labels
identity_cols = [
    "male",
    "female",
    "homosexual_gay_or_lesbian",
    "christian",
    "jewish",
    "muslim",
    "black",
    "white",
    "psychiatric_or_mental_illness",
]

for col in identity_cols:
    train_df[col] = (train_df[col].fillna(0) >= 0.5).astype(float)
train_df["has_identity"] = train_df["identity_annotator_count"] > 0

# Split train/validation
train_data, val_data = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.1, stratify=(train_df["target"] >= 0.5), random_state=42
)


# Dataset class
class ToxicityDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tokenizer):
        self.df = df
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        text = row["comment_text"]
        target = torch.tensor(row["target"], dtype=torch.float)
        identity_labels = torch.tensor(row[identity_cols].values, dtype=torch.float)
        has_id = torch.tensor(row["has_identity"], dtype=torch.bool)

        encoding = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        return {
            "input_ids": encoding["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "attention_mask": encoding["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "target": target,
            "identity_labels": identity_labels,
            "has_identity": has_id,
        }


# Gradient reversal layer
class GradientReversal(torch.autograd.Function):
    @staticmethod
    def forward(ctx, x, alpha):
        ctx.alpha = alpha
        return x

    @staticmethod
    def backward(ctx, grad_output):
        return grad_output.neg() * ctx.alpha, None


class DebiasedBERT(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.bert = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)
        self.toxicity_head = nn.Linear(768, 1)
        self.adv_head = nn.Linear(768, len(identity_cols))

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, alpha=0.15):
        outputs = self.bert(input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        pooled = self.dropout(pooled)

        # Toxicity prediction
        toxicity = self.toxicity_head(pooled).squeeze()

        # Adversarial branch with gradient reversal
        rev_pooled = GradientReversal.apply(pooled, alpha)
        identities = self.adv_head(rev_pooled)

        return toxicity, identities


# Initialize components
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
train_dataset = ToxicityDataset(train_data, tokenizer)
val_dataset = ToxicityDataset(val_data, tokenizer)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=4
)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=4)

model = DebiasedBERT().to(DEVICE)
opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-5)
tox_criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
adv_criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()

# Training loop
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for batch in train_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(DEVICE)
        attn_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(DEVICE)
        targets = batch["target"].to(DEVICE)
        id_labels = batch["identity_labels"].to(DEVICE)
        has_id = batch["has_identity"].to(DEVICE)

        opt.zero_grad()
        tox_logits, adv_logits = model(input_ids, attn_mask)

        # Toxicity loss
        tox_loss = tox_criterion(tox_logits, targets)

        # Adversarial loss (only on identity-labeled samples)
        if has_id.any():
            adv_loss = adv_criterion(adv_logits[has_id], id_labels[has_id])
        else:
            adv_loss = 0

        total_loss = tox_loss + 0.2 * adv_loss
        total_loss.backward()
        opt.step()

# Validation
model.eval()
val_preds, val_targets = [], []
with torch.no_grad():

    @staticmethod
    def backward(ctx, grad_output):
        return grad_output.neg() * ctx.alpha, None
